sentences.text:
Respondent :- Union Of India And Another
Counsel for Petitioner :- Bharat Pratap Singh,Gopal Krishna

Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,Kuldeep Singh Chauhan
Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed today, is taken on record.
Heard Sri Kuldeep Singh Chauhan, learned Advocate appearing for the respondent no. 2.

The petitioner herein claims to be the owner of plot no. 148/1 total area of which is 14200 sq. meter.,
a copy of the Khatauni of the aforesaid plot is appended at page 11 of the paper book.

A perusal thereof indicates that an area of 7256.40 sq. meter of Gata No. 148/1 has been utilized for the project by Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Ltd., respondent no. 2 for its project.

entities.text: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: There remains an area of 6943.60 sq. meter of Gata number 148/1mtr. in the name of the petitioner and other co-tenure holders.

Further 634 sq. meter excess land has been acquired by Railways Naresh Pal Singh vs Union Of India And Another on 14 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60438060/
1 Authority.
The contention in the supplementary affidavit filed today is that on account of execution of the project by respondent no. 2, the remaining area of 6310 sq. meter which is in possession of the petitioner has become useless, i.e. the land in question cannot be utilized for agricultural operations in view of the execution of the project by respondent no. 2.

entities.text: Railways Naresh Pal Singh vs Union Of India And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has invited attention of the Court to the provisions of Section 20-F (3) of the Railways Act, 1989 to submit that in case the right of user or any right in the nature of an easement on any land is acquired under the Railways Act, 1989 is disturbed, the owner or any other person whose right of enjoyment at that land has been affected in any manner by the acquisition, shall be entitled to payment of compensation.

The submission, thus, is that a representation has been filed before the competent authority for determination of compensation for the remaining area of 6310 sq. meter of plot no. 148/1, which though has not been acquired but has become waste by reason of acquisition of the part thereof.

Noticing the above, without entering into the claim of the petitioner, the present petition is being disposed of with the observation that the petitioner may make an application before the 'competent authority' within the meaning of Railways Act, 1989, by moving an appropriate application raising his grievances along with the copy of this order.
In the said application, all the co-tenure holders of land in question shall be impleaded.

On such application being made within a period of two weeks from today, the competent authority shall be under obligation to take an expeditious decision by passing a reasoned and speaking order strictly in accordance with law within a further period of six weeks.
It goes without saying that independent consideration shall be given to the claim of the petitioner and the competent authority shall not be guided by any of the observations made herein above.

Order Date :- 14.3.2023 Nisha  Naresh Pal Singh vs Union Of India And Another on 14 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60438060/
